Living Well / Resource directory

Organize a thought and choose a next step

Start with life

What would be useful?

Keep a small piece of useful information available without turning every idea into an obligation.

The simpler starting point: Start in the paper notebook or note app you already use. Three headings can be enough: action, reference, and question.

Finish when: Close the note, find it again, and identify the one action you actually intend to take.

Choose by fit

Different tools, different jobs.

These are editorial comparisons based on public descriptions, not a ranking from hands-on tests. Choose one suitable route; using every option is not the goal.

Simplenote: a small shared note

Consider it when: You need a small non-sensitive note across devices.

Check first: Read the provider’s storage warning and keep intimate or security-sensitive records elsewhere.

Access: Free service; an account is required. Collaboration requires participants to have accounts.

Open Simplenote: a small shared note · Full context and source

Obsidian: local notes

Consider it when: You want a locally kept collection of linked notes.

Check first: Begin without plugins and understand how the files will be backed up.

Access: Core app is free without an account. Optional Sync and Publish services are paid. A compatible device is needed.

Open Obsidian: local notes · Full context and source

Joplin

Consider it when: You already use Joplin or want a notebook with documented export choices.

Check first: Test opening an export rather than assuming that a format name guarantees portability.

Access: The note-taking apps are free and open source. Joplin Cloud and some services are paid options.

Explore Joplin · Full context and source

Google Keep: collaboration basics

Consider it when: Another person needs to edit a short list with you.

Check first: Agree ownership and responsibilities before granting edit access.

Access: The guide is free to read. Using shared Keep notes requires suitable Google accounts and access to the service.

Open Google Keep: collaboration basics · Full context and source

draw.io: make an idea visible

Consider it when: The problem is a sequence or relationship that is hard to express in a list.

Check first: Keep a text explanation with the diagram.

Access: Free browser editor without a required account; a desktop option is available. Some integrations and storage services have separate terms.

Open draw.io: make an idea visible · Full context and source

From choice to use

Keep the human purpose visible.

Keep a small original

Use a few notes you own, not an inbox export. Preserve uncertainties and conditions before asking any tool to reorganize them.

Give assistance one job

Optional AI grouping should separate actions from references, not invent priorities or deadlines. Review every proposed action against its source.

Return to the actual task

A tidier note is an intermediate result. Take the chosen step, deliberately schedule it, or decide not to pursue it. Stop reorganizing once the note serves that choice.

Published as a selection path, not a personal field note. Source dates and access limits belong to each resource. No paid placement or affiliation is implied.
